name: Halimar Depths
oracle_text:
This land enters tapped.
When this land enters, look at the top three cards of your library, then put them back in any order.
{T}: Add {U}.
blocked_sentences: When this land enters, look at the top three cards of your library, then put them back in any order.

needs.what: A way for look_at_top to put the cards looked at and not taken back on top of the library in an order the resolving player chooses (rule 401.4, as put_on_top's any_order does via _in_owners_order) -- here with nothing taken at all: look at the top three, reorder them, put all three back on top
needs.why_existing_wont_do: look_at_top leaves untaken cards on top in their original order, so the printed ordering choice never happens; rest_to_bottom sends them to the bottom in random order and rest_to only names a zone; put_on_top has any_order but no selector can name 'the top three cards of your library' and look_at_top's `as` binds only cards it moved; scry orders the top but also allows bottoming any of them, which is a strictly better card (Ponder's shipped scry spelling is that approximation)
